CVE-2026-74859.title: The shell theme installer in gnome-tweaks extracts user-supplied  ...
CVE-2026-74859.description: The shell theme installer in gnome-tweaks extracts user-supplied ZIP archives without validating archive member paths. As a result, a crafted theme archive can write files outside ~/.themes by using ../ path traversal, absolute paths, or symlink entries.
